Re-listen (15 min): your favourite episode or video of this week, without the text. Shadow 1 minute of it.

Write (20 min): 150–200 words on [LangCorrect](https://langcorrect.com/) giving your view on «Культура: кино, книги, музеи, туризм, национальные традиции», with arguments for and against. When the corrections come, read the corrected text out loud 3 times.
Final talk rehearsal (20 min): choose a topic from your field for a 10-minute talk, put the key words on one card, and practise it out loud twice.
Anki (15 min): reviews only.

Weekly check (20 min): how many minutes did you speak this week (target: 210)? How many hours did you listen (target: 7)? Which 3 mistakes came up most in your error log? What can you say now that you couldn't last week? Under 180 minutes of speaking? Next week, cut grammar time, not speaking.

Passive listening (30–60 min): [ПостНаука](https://www.youtube.com/@postnauka) or [Arzamas](https://arzamas.academy/) lectures, or a [Mosfilm](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEK3tT7DcfWGWJpNEDBdWog) film. No pausing, no notes.
Listen back to this week's recordings (10 min): note one thing that's better than last week.
Anki (15 min): reviews only.
Monthly recording (10 min): answer «Расскажи о себе и о своей жизни в Ташкенте» for 2 minutes without notes, and listen to it next to your previous one.
Final talk (30 min): give your 10-minute talk to Russian speakers (friends, colleagues, an online group) and take 10 minutes of questions. Record it.

Automatic check: Tasks 1–4 · Tasks 5–8 · Tasks 9–12 · Task 13 · Task 14 · Task 15 · Accuracy at speed · Fluency. Which came out right in this month's conversations without a correction? Drill the others again next week.
Anki (15 min): reviews only.
Catch-up (60 min): finish the tasks you missed this month (days that aren't green in the grid above).
Final talk feedback (20 min): ask a native speaker what to work on next, and put it in your error log.
Optional: if you want a certificate, find an authorised ТРКИ test centre and book the B2 exam.
Look back (10 min): listen to your day 1 recording, then today's. That's 300 days of work.
